name: Kell Village
description: The free town below the monastery, and the one settlement on this coast the Steward has never resolved: it shows in the records as a maintenance liability with an unusual headcount. Nobody here is allocated anything. They trade, they argue, they mend their own roofs badly, and they keep the valley road open.

variants.description: The free town below the monastery, with a memorial by the gate: a hundred and sixty-four names from 2148 and a line of hand-forged blades hung above them. They drill on Sundays, which is either a tradition or a warning depending on who you ask.

The free town below the monastery, and quieter than you remember it. A Steward sentry drone holds station over the square. Half the market stalls are shuttered and nobody meets your eye, and it is not you they are avoiding.
